proposed_changes: Disable public brain-corpus export with an inert workflow and no permissions.
Replace the exporter with an inert entry point that reads no credentials, makes no network calls and writes no files.
Remove the two generated corpus dumps from the proposed current tree without rewriting Git history.
Disable the broad manual merge queue and remove branch-update, approval, comment and merge capabilities.
Restrict unattended scheduler dispatch to two input-free read-only validation workflows; reject tampered entries, unapproved names, inputs and timezone-naive timestamps.
Serialize scheduler ticks and bound execution time.
Make Cross Analysis read-only and upload bounded artifacts instead of committing generated data to main.
Register four focused regression test modules in core CI.
limitations: Scheduler retains contents:write and actions:write for queue persistence and allowlisted dispatch; it is constrained, not fully read-only.
Current-tree deletion does not erase historical Git objects, forks, caches or external copies.
No individual corpus records were inspected, classified, redacted or relocated.
Administrative branch-protection and required-check enforcement remain unverified.
Cross Analysis outputs move to bounded workflow artifacts; a separately approved private durable destination is not established by this PR.
The proposed changes were copied from the previously exact-head-tested PR #1555; this new head still requires its own GitHub CI and fail-closed verification.
